title: Zanzibar Cardamom Bread
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Zanzibar Cardamom Bread — a soft, sweet enriched loaf perfumed heavily with Zanzibar cardamom, topped with sesame seeds and a honey glaze. The island's most fragrant morning bread — the smell of cardamom from the oven is one of Zanzibar's great morning experiences.
longDesc: Zanzibar cardamom bread is the most aromatic bread on the island — the generous amount of locally grown cardamom produces a loaf whose fragrance fills the whole building. Made for Eid and for the most honoured occasions, it is the bread that signals something special is happening.
ingredients: // Topping: 1 egg beaten + sesame seeds + 2 tbsp honey mixed with 1 tbsp water
steps: See TZA128 (Mkate wa Sinia) for the full technique — cardamom bread uses the same enriched dough method.
Use 1.5 tsp cardamom (double) and add nutmeg.
Brush with egg wash. Scatter sesame seeds generously.
Brush with honey glaze while still hot from the oven.
chefTips: Double the cardamom of a normal bread — this is Zanzibar.
The honey glaze while hot creates a shiny, fragrant crust.
commonMistakes: Cold honey glaze — does not adhere.
cookingScience: See TZA128 for enriched bread science.
sustainabilityTips: Zanzibar cardamom — the island's own crop.
culturalNote: Zanzibar cardamom bread is the island's most fragrant food — its smell from the oven is the smell of celebration, of Eid morning, of the most important days in the Zanzibari year.
